A boxed pair of ZeroStick Pro replacement joystick modules for the PS5 DualSense Edge, built around K-Silver TMR (Tunneling Magnetoresistance) magnetic sensors. Magnetic, contactless sensing means there is no carbon wiper to wear down, so stick drift never develops. Both modules are calibrated and tested before they leave us.

  • True drift-free performance — TMR magnetic sensors remove the mechanical wiper contact that causes stick drift.
  • Extended lifespan — rated 50,000,000+ cycles, and 5–10x the life of a traditional potentiometer stick.
  • Zero added latency — reports identically to the stock module.
  • Plug and play — direct drop-in replacement for the DualSense Edge stick module, no soldering.
  • Calibrated out of the box, and calibration stays user-unlocked.
  • 5-year stick warranty.
